title: The Covid vaccine passports with Dr. Joe Mercola
description:
Bulletproof Radio Episode #816
https://daveasprey.com/dr-joseph-mercola-816/

In this episode of Bulletproof Radio, Dr. Joe Mercola returns to talk about the topic that’s been on everyone’s mind, for better or worse, for over a year. That would be Covid-19. Dr. Joe’s been on the show multiple times because he’s been on the cutting-edge of health for the last 25 years and isn’t afraid to question the status quo in healthcare. He’s a best-selling author, an expert in the field of natural health and the founder of the health website Mercola.com.

This is the calm place where you can hear this episode and be like, “I don’t really believe all of that,” or, “I believe all that,” or, “There’s a lot more. They didn’t talk about the aliens.” All of the above is okay, right? So, peace, community, joy, love, and disagreement all at the same time.

Here’s some of what we cover:

    Dr. Joe’s newest book: “The Truth About COVID-19: Exposing the Great Reset, Lockdowns, Vaccine Passports, and the New Normal” and his global-mission oriented writing/research process
    How censorship, on several levels by several giant companies, has impacted what we believe about the virus (and the censorship of Dr. Joe’s work itself)
    The vaccine: its origins, the research behind it and why it might not be your best treatment option
    Alternative therapies for preventing and abating the symptoms of long-COVID
    Vaccine Passports, their roll-out through private companies and their consequences
    Disrupting and investigating the echo chamber of disinformation, and how Joe plans to share more information in the face of censorship

Maybe Dr. Jo has a different opinion than you, but I don’t want that to get in the way of you getting information from all backgrounds.

60 Minutes, the most successful American television broadcast in history, began its 52nd season in September.
